text:
maria: FYI customer reported intermittent missing final tokens on SSE chat streams. They say the stream ends abruptly without the final punctuation sometimes. Request ID they gave: req_1790002345_8f3a2c. Model: redwood-1, region: eu-west-1. They are on a corporate proxy (BlueLayerCorp v2.1) and using Chrome 109. Debug bundle link: https://debug.redwood/bugs/4623 (they attached server logs + HAR). Can we collect repro steps and what to ask them for?
samir: thanks. first quick ask: do we have the edge logs for that request id? can someone pull nginx/haproxy edge traces for req_1790002345_8f3a2c? need timing of last chunk and connection close.
eli: also ask customer to repro with raw curl no buffering: `curl -v --no-buffer -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?model=redwood-1\"` — send a short prompt and capture stdout to file. 
maria: i attached their curl verbatim in the debug bundle but it had some app-layer wrapper. i'll ask them to run your exact command and paste the full trace.
tasha: common cause: reverse proxy or CDN buffer can swallow the trailing chunk if connection closes without proper flush. nginx default buffer or proxy_buffering on can do this. ask them to try bypassing corporate proxy (or test from home network) if possible.
samir: good. also request them to run `tcpdump -w /tmp/req.pcap host api.redwood.com and port 443` during the repro if they can; that'll show whether TLS close happens before final chunk. provide instructions to redact sensitive fields.
eli: here's a minimal curl repro suggestion we can send to customer (explicit code block):
```
# minimal repro (no buffering)
curl -v --no-buffer \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>\" \
  -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\",\"max_tokens\":30}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?model=redwood-1
```
Ask them to replace <REDACTED_TOKEN> with their key and run from the machine showing the issue. capture full stdout and stderr.
tasha: also include an nginx troubleshooting snippet they can hand to their infra team (if they control the proxy):
```
# nginx recommendation
location /v1/streams/ {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
  proxy_set_header Connection \"\";
}
```
maria: sending this now. adding a checklist to request: full curl trace, HAR, tcpdump (if allowed), confirm if they see the issue from a phone network, and the exact client library (EventSource? fetch SSE polyfill?).
support-bot: :white_check_mark: internal ticket created: INT-4623. Assigned to @samir. Linked debug bundle.
samir: once we get their tcpdump/pcap, we should look for TLS close_notify timing and whether the last SSE event is chunked but not flushed. also check our LB logs for a premature FIN from the backend.
eli: smaller thing to try for customer quickly: in Chrome devtools -> network -> preserve log -> see if final event actually arrives in browser. sometimes the app buffers before printing. ask them to open the event stream in a raw terminal to rule out UI buffering.
maria: customer replied: \"we can repro via curl sometimes, about 1 in 5 runs.\" they attached two curl outputs, one truncated. pushing for tcpdump but their security team is slow. they allowed a server-side trace if we can trigger it from our side using the request id.
tasha: we can enable debug proxy capture for that req_id from our edge for a short window. @maria please confirm timeframe when they plan to run repro so we can collect.
maria: they plan to run at 14:30 UTC today. i've scheduled edge capture and asked infra to keep logs for +1hr.
samir: excellent. if we confirm it's proxy buffering then we can recommend `proxy_buffering off` and `proxy_set_header Connection \"keep-alive\"` fixes. if it's our side, look at our stream flush call when sending final tokens — there was a recent change in the flushing path in the stream runtime (PR #3207). i'll put a quick canary to reproduce locally.
eli: one more diagnostic: ask them to add header `X-Debug-Request: req_1790002345_8f3a2c` in the curl so we can correlate easily in our edge logs. also ask for `x-forwarded-for` when available.
maria: noted. i'm sending the headers snippet and the curl example + nginx snippet. will post their outputs here when they reply. :pray:
support-bot: :information_source: Reminder: attach customer consent form if collecting pcap.
maria: agreed — customer signed the pcap consent, sent by email. will paste logs here when available.
eli: thanks. i'll stand by to run the local canary and compare traces once we have the edge capture.
